ei.title: Chapter 3-08 1번: Irrigated Agriculture and Ancient Cities
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers ①<u>obtained</u> their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually ②<u>suggested</u> that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system ③<u>have</u> a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and ④<u>possible</u> for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ have → has: 주어가 this type of primitive subsistence system(단수)이므로 단수 동사 has가 적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① obtained — 과거형, obtained their food supply 적절
❌ ② suggested — 과거분사, it is usually suggested 수동태 적절
✅ ③ have — 원문은 has. 주어 this type(단수)에 복수 동사 have는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ possible — 형용사, made it necessary and possible 적절
det.tip: this type of ~ system + has (단수 주어 → 단수 동사)

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region ①<u>where</u> they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant ②<u>pointing out</u> that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus ③<u>available</u> within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river ④<u>used</u> for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② pointing out → to point out: It seems relevant to point out에서 가주어 It + to부정사(진주어) 구문. 동명사 pointing out은 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① where — 관계부사, in the region where they were located 적절
✅ ② pointing out — 원문은 to point out. It seems more relevant to point out 구문에서 가주어 It + to부정사 ←정답
❌ ③ available — 형용사 후치수식, the total surplus available 적절
❌ ④ used — 과거분사, the river used for irrigation 적절
det.tip: It seems + 형용사 + to V (가주어-진주어 구문)

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive ①<u>irrigated</u> agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it ②<u>necessary</u> and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus ③<u>availably</u> within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river ④<u>used</u> for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ availably → available: the total surplus available(이용 가능한)은 surplus를 후치 수식하는 형용사. 부사 availably는 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① irrigated — 과거분사/형용사, intensive irrigated agriculture 명사 수식 적절
❌ ② necessary — 형용사, made it necessary and possible 적절
✅ ③ availably — 원문은 available. the total surplus available(형용사 후치수식)에서 부사형 availably는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ used — 과거분사, the river used for irrigation 적절
det.tip: the total surplus available: 형용사(available)의 후치 수식

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers ①<u>obtained</u> their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more ②<u>irrelevant</u> to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it ③<u>necessary</u> and possible for a ④<u>large</u> number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '무관한(irrelevant)'이 아니라 '관련 있는(relevant)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 이 체계의 높은 생산량을 지적하는 것이 더 관련 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① obtained — 얻다, 원문 일치
✅ ② irrelevant — 원문은 relevant(관련 있는). 원시적 자급 체계의 높은 생산량을 지적하는 것이 더 관련 있다는 문맥 ←정답
❌ ③ necessary — 필요한, 원문 일치
❌ ④ large — 큰, 원문 일치
det.tip: relevant(관련 있는) ↔ irrelevant(무관한)

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from ①<u>intensive</u> irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly ②<u>high</u> with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a ③<u>small</u> area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat ④<u>obstruction</u> of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '방해(obstruction)'가 아니라 '수송(transport)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 관개 수로가 도시로 식량을 보트로 수송하는 데 사용된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① intensive — 집약적인, 원문 일치
❌ ② high — 높은, 원문 일치
❌ ③ small — 작은, 원문 일치
✅ ④ obstruction — 원문은 transport(수송). 관개 수로가 식량 수송에 사용된다는 맥락에서 obstruction(방해)은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: transport(수송) ↔ obstruction(방해, 장애)

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the __________ per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가족당 잉여(surplus)가 작더라도 총 잉여는 클 것이다. 빈칸 자리는 'the _____ per family is small'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① demand — 수요: the demand per family is small은 문맥과 부적합. 본문은 잉여의 크기를 논의
❌ ② output — 생산량: 생산량은 높다고 했지 가족당 작다는 맥락 아님
❌ ③ agriculture — 농업: 명사이나 the agriculture per family는 어색
✅ ④ surplus — 잉여: even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus will be large ←정답
det.tip: surplus per family = 가족당 잉여

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because __________ is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 관개 농업에서 노동 생산성(labor productivity)이 특히 높다는 것이 통상적으로 시사된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① food supply — 식량 공급: 'food supply is particularly high'는 어색. 공급이 높다는 표현 부자연스러움
✅ ② labor productivity — 노동 생산성: it is usually suggested that labor productivity is particularly high ←정답
❌ ③ boat transport — 보트 수송: 마지막 문장 맥락이지 여기서 높다고 한 대상 아님
❌ ④ irrigation canals — 관개 수로: 수로가 높다는 표현 부자연스러움
det.tip: labor productivity is particularly high = 노동 생산성이 특히 높다

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문에서 이 원시적 자급 체계가 '단위 면적당 특히 높은 생산량(a particularly high output per unit of land)'을 가진다고 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 단위 면적당 높은 생산량 — a particularly high output per unit of land 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 수렵과 채집 — 원문은 intensive irrigated agriculture(집약적 관개 농업)
❌ ③ 각 가족의 잉여가 큼 — 원문은 even if the surplus per family is small(가족당 잉여가 작더라도)
❌ ④ 오직 농업용 — 원문은 can be used for boat transport(보트 수송에도 사용 가능)
det.tip: a particularly high output per unit of land

ch: 관개 농업은 단위 면적당 높은 생산량을 가진다.
고대 도시들은 수렵과 채집으로 식량을 조달했다.
각 가족의 잉여가 크기 때문에 도시 근처에 사는 것이 가능했다.

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 'even if the surplus per family is small(가족당 잉여가 작더라도) 총 잉여가 크다'라고 했다. 가족당 잉여가 크다는 것은 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 관개 농업 — obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture 일치
❌ ② 노동 생산성 — it is usually suggested that labor productivity is particularly high 일치
❌ ③ 많은 가족 좁은 지역 — made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area 일치
✅ ④ 가족당 잉여가 큼 — 원문은 even if the surplus per family is small. 가족당 잉여가 크다고 한 적 없음 ←정답
det.tip: even if the surplus per family is small — 가족당 잉여는 작다

ch: 고대 도시들은 관개 농업에서 식량을 얻었다.
관개 농업의 노동 생산성이 높다는 것이 통상적 견해이다.
단위 면적당 높은 노동 수요로 많은 가족이 좁은 지역에 살았다.
가족당 잉여가 크기 때문에 총 잉여도 클 수밖에 없다.

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문 마지막 문장에서 관개 수로나 강이 식량을 도시로 보트 수송하는 데 사용될 수 있다(can be used for boat transport of food to the town)고 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 전적으로 동의 — 원문은 It seems more relevant to point out(더 관련 있다고 지적), 통상적 견해와 다른 관점 제시
❌ ② 노동 수요가 낮음 — 원문은 The high demand for labor(높은 노동 수요)
✅ ③ 식량 수송 활용 — can be used for boat transport of food to the town 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 먼 거리에서도 — 원문은 within a fairly small distance from the town(도시에서 꽤 가까운 거리)
det.tip: irrigation canals can be used for boat transport of food

ch: 필자는 노동 생산성이 높다는 통상적 견해에 전적으로 동의한다.
관개 농업은 단위 면적당 노동 수요가 낮다.
관개 수로나 강은 식량 수송에도 활용 가능하다.
도시와 먼 거리에서도 충분한 잉여를 확보할 수 있다.

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체가 관개 농업이 단위 면적당 높은 생산량을 가져 많은 가족이 좁은 지역에 살 수 있게 되고, 총 잉여가 커서 도시가 형성될 수 있었다는 내용.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 고대 문명의 몰락 — 본문은 도시 형성을 다루지 몰락은 언급 없음
✅ ② 관개 농업 + 도시 형성 — 핵심: high output per unit of land → large number of families in small area → large total surplus ←정답
❌ ③ 현대 도시 계획 — 본문은 고대(ancient) 도시에 관한 것
❌ ④ 기술 혁신 — 본문은 기존 관개 농업의 특성 분석이지 혁신 논의 아님
det.tip: irrigated agriculture → high output per unit of land → ancient urban centers

ch: 고대 문명의 몰락과 농업 기술의 한계
관개 농업의 높은 면적당 생산량과 고대 도시 형성의 관계
노동 생산성 향상을 위한 기술 혁신의 필요성

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 필자는 통상적 견해(노동 생산성이 높다)보다 면적당 높은 생산량이 핵심이라고 주장한다. 좁은 지역에 많은 가족 → 총 잉여 축적.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 노동 생산성 — 통상적 견해(usually suggested)이지 필자의 요지 아님. 필자는 면적당 생산량이 더 관련 있다고 주장
❌ ② 가족당 잉여 적으면 불가능 — 원문은 even if surplus per family is small, total surplus will be large. 가족당 잉여가 작아도 가능
❌ ③ 다양한 방법 — 본문은 관개 농업 하나에 초점
✅ ④ 높은 면적당 생산량 + 대규모 잉여 — 필자의 핵심 주장: output per unit of land → 많은 가족 밀집 → total surplus large ←정답
det.tip: 필자 주장 ≠ 통상적 견해. 면적당 생산량이 핵심

ch: 관개 농업은 노동 생산성이 높아 고대 도시의 성장을 이끌었다.
가족당 잉여가 적으면 도시 형성이 불가능하다.
고대 도시들은 다양한 식량 조달 방법을 활용했다.
관개 농업의 높은 면적당 생산량이 좁은 지역 내 대규모 잉여 축적을 가능하게 했다.

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where they were located, and <u>it</u> is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 It seems more relevant to point out가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '더 관련 있는 것을 지적하는 것이 적절해 보인다'는 앞의 통상적 견해(노동 생산성)보다 더 핵심적인 요인(면적당 생산량)이 있다는 필자의 관점 전환을 나타낸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 통상적 설명보다 핵심적 요인 — it is usually suggested(통상적) vs It seems more relevant(필자 판단): 관점 전환 ←정답
❌ ② 전적 뒷받침 — more relevant는 기존 설명과 다른 관점을 제시하는 것
❌ ③ 문제점 비판 — 관개 농업의 다른 측면을 강조하는 것이지 비판이 아님
❌ ④ 축하 표현 — 학술적 논증이지 축하가 아님
det.tip: It seems more relevant = 필자가 기존 통설과 다른 관점을 제시할 때 쓰는 학술적 표현

ch: 통상적으로 제시되는 설명보다 더 핵심적인 요인이 있다는 필자의 판단

questions.passage: Many of the ancient urban centers obtained their food supply from intensive irrigated agriculture in the region where <u>they</u> were located, and it is usually suggested that this is because labor productivity is particularly high with irrigated agriculture. It seems more relevant to point out that this type of primitive subsistence system has a particularly high output per unit of land. The high demand for labor per unit of land and the high output per unit of land made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area. Therefore, even if the surplus per family is small, the total surplus available within a fairly small distance from the town will be large. In addition, the irrigation canals, or the river used for irrigation, can be used for boat transport of food to the town.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 첫 번째 문장 'in the region where they were located'에서 they는 앞의 Many of the ancient urban centers(고대 도시 중심지)를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 식량 공급원 — 추상 개념, 위치(located)의 주체 아님
✅ ② 고대 도시 중심지 — Many of the ancient urban centers... where they were located: they = urban centers ←정답
❌ ③ 관개 농업 기술 — 아직 언급 전
❌ ④ 관개 수로 — 마지막 문장에 등장, 첫 문장과 무관
det.tip: the region where they were located: 그것들(고대 도시들)이 위치한 지역

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세 번째 문장 'made it necessary and possible for a large number of families to live within a small area'에서 it은 가주어이며, 진목적어는 for a large number of families to live within a small area이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 단위 면적당 생산량 — it의 지시대상이 아님
❌ ② 원시적 자급 체계 — 앞 문장의 주어이나 여기서 it은 가주어
✅ ③ 가주어 — made it necessary and possible for ~ to V: it = 가주어, for~to V = 진목적어 ←정답
❌ ④ 관개 농업 — 여기서 it은 가주어
det.tip: make it + 형용사 + for A to V: 가주어(it) + 진목적어(for A to V)
